sofia_cs: Heads-up — doing a financial tuning preflight for Atlasica. Large embedding import caused a spike in the last 48h and triggered a budget alert. Opening a thread to gather forecast numbers, renewal impact, and enablement actions.
ethan_ae: Noted. Renewal is EOM — execs will want numbers and options. Can CS get a 30/60/90 spend forecast + top 3 usage drivers?
priya_fin: I can run the projections. Need tokens by route + embedding calls. @leo_platform can you post a quick query or CSV?
leo_platform: Pushed a quick query to the logs. Sample SQL I'm using: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as d, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM requests
WHERE account = 'atlasica'
GROUP BY d
ORDER BY d DESC
LIMIT 30;
``` I'll attach the CSV to ticket #12345.
megan_finance: Tagged this for finance review. If they breach committed tier, finance will propose a temporary cushion credit. What is their current committed tier?
sofia_cs: Committed tier: Dedicated 100M tokens/mo. Last 7-day avg ~9M/day => ~270M/mo. Alert fired on ~2x overage. This was triggered by a bulk embedding ingestion during onboarding.
cost-alert-bot: ALERT: account=atlasica exceeded 120% of monthly commit at 1744444000 — notifying @sofia_cs @megan_finance
priya_fin: That puts renewal risk on the table. My preliminary options: 1) temporary bump to 300M for 30 days, 2) one-off customer credit to smooth renewal conversation, 3) immediate enablement session + throttles. Which should we present?
ethan_ae: Customer tends to push back on price moves. Need a short enablement playbook they can share with engineering + cost impact estimates. @sofia_cs can you draft?
sofia_cs: Will draft a short playbook: 'batch embedding uploads', 'prefix caching', 'trim doc lengths', and SDK defaults. I'll estimate cost delta for each recommendation.
leo_platform: SDK guidance: recommend `batch_size=16`, `max_input_tokens=1024`, enable KV cache for repeated calls. Quick snippet: ```python
client.generate(..., batch_size=16, timeout=60)
``` Also will publish a small dashboard link for them.
megan_finance: If we apply a credit, finance needs expected delta revenue, impact on renewal probability, and precedent examples. Priya — can you produce 2 slides for the QBR (baseline / surge / mitigation)? Need by EOD tomorrow.
priya_fin: On it — baseline, surge-case, and mitigation + recommended ask.
sofia_cs: Capturing customer feedback: they want per-route quotas and an ingestion guide. I'll prepare an 'ingestion checklist' to reduce accidental spikes and attach to the ticket.
cost-alert-bot: NOTE: ticket #12345 updated with CSV export s3://redwood-exports/atlasica/1744444444_tokens.csv
megan_finance: :thumbsup: Finance holds a 2% discretionary reserve for credits. If approved, we need PO/approval before month-end to apply to their invoice.
priya_fin: Marking renewal risk status: ELEVATED for QBR. Will include recommended paths: 'credit + enablement', 'tier bump', 're-rate vs committed usage'.
ethan_ae: Action items recap: Sofia — customer-facing playbook & ingestion checklist; Priya — slides + forecast; Megan — check credit policy & approval path; Leo — attach CSV + spin up readonly dashboard; Ethan — draft renewal narrative for execs. Sync tomorrow 11:00am PT.
sofia_cs: I'll DM customer with a proposed 1hr enablement slot tomorrow afternoon and attach the playbook. I'll update this thread after the session. Thanks all.
